title: Typography review confirms undersized preview labels and mobile text
summary: The owner reports that the redesigned preview's font and text size are too small. Source review found 139 font-size declarations below 14px, including operational labels, table content, buttons and mobile overrides in the 8–13px range. The body shorthand is 15px, and a Segoe-first system stack may render differently across devices. This supports a focused typography correction: use an embedded Inter font, a 16px body, 14–15px operational secondary text and layout reflow rather than font shrinking at narrow widths. Existing production source and provider behavior are outside this change.

evidence.description: Existing font-size declarations and responsive overrides establish the small-text cause.

evidence.location: Owner font/readability feedback on the current preview
evidence.description: Font size and font appear too small; asks for a recheck.

nextSteps: Apply a centralized readable type scale and embedded Inter assets, then inspect actual rendered sizes and responsive layouts.
